listing.name: Super Mario Galaxy — GalaxyPad (chrissotraidis)
listing.summary: Upstream reports an experimental iPhone 14 build running at about 60 FPS. A complete playthrough has not been confirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA RMGE01 revision 0 disc in WBFS form.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use PadMint to build from your own image on Apple Silicon or through a CI service you are authorized to use. No ready-built IPA is offered.

warnings: Upstream reports an experimental iPhone 14 build running at about 60 FPS. A complete playthrough has not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
